meta.note: Torah #148 has zero cause/effect (eitza or cause) edges in torahData.js. The Torah is a three-line philosophical aphorism about the infinite recursive nature of יִרְאָה. Its entire content consists of bechina-type relationships (what things ARE aspects of each other): ענוה ↔ יראה, חכמה ↔ יראה, יראה ↔ אין סוף. There is no causal flow described — no concept produces or leads to another. The teaching observes that fear of God IS itself afraid, that humility's heel IS fear, and that wisdom's beginning IS fear — all identity/aspect statements, not cause-and-effect. Therefore there are no unassigned cause/effect nodes to enrich into packages.
